title: Jets GM Darren Mougey addresses canceled Top 30 visit with NFL Draft prospect David Bailey

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jets GM Darren Mougey addresses canceled Top 30 visit with NFL Draft prospect David Bailey
sources.description: Jets GM Darren Mougey acknowledged that the team did nix a scheduled Top 30 visit with potential NFL Draft pick David Bailey, but that people shouldn’t “look too much into a cancellation."
